import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    
    c = [0] * 35
    tmp = m
    ind = 0
    f = True
    
    while tmp > 0:
        c[ind] += tmp % w
        if c[ind] == w:
            c[ind] = 0
            c[ind + 1] += 1
        if c[ind] > 1:
            if c[ind] == w - 1:
                c[ind + 1] += 1
            else:
                f = False
                break
        tmp //= w
        ind += 1
    
    print("YES" if f else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
